# Worked example: the garden-to-table weekly menu

The demo's third topic, `g2t`, imports the community garden and the neighborhood kitchen. The user asks: "Write the
weekly menu brief for the kitchen volunteers."

## The call

```
onto_context task="write the weekly menu"
```

It picks the `brief` template (its sections fit the task best) and returns the goal, the constraints, the decision
on when the menu locks, the ids for each heading and the open gaps. Its last line reads, for example:

```
left out to fit 1000 tokens: 3 quotes (onto_get id=kitchen/deliverable:weekly-menu full=true)
```

The brief needs one quote for the allergen rule, so one follow-up call: `onto_get id=kitchen/constraint:allergen-labels`.

## The deliverable

```markdown
# Weekly menu brief

_g2t v1 | richness 52 working | imports: garden v1 a1b2c3d ok, kitchen v1 9e8f7a6 ok_

## Goal
A weekly harvest menu: the kitchen cooks what the garden picks each week (`goal:weekly-harvest-menu`). It is
measured by the share of local produce on the menu (`metric:local-produce-share`).

## People and roles
The menu planner owns menu planning (`kitchen/role:menu-planner`, `kitchen/process:menu-planning`). Line cooks
prepare the dishes (`kitchen/role:line-cook`). In the garden, bed stewards tend the tomatoes
(`garden/role:bed-steward`).

## Data and sources
Menu planning reads the garden's harvest log (`kitchen/process:menu-planning` consumes `garden/dataset:harvest-log`,
a bridge) and the recipe binder (`kitchen/dataset:recipe-binder`).

## Processes
Menu planning produces the weekly menu (`kitchen/deliverable:weekly-menu`). Tomato salad is on it all summer
(`kitchen/dish:tomato-salad`); its tomatoes are the garden's (`garden/crop:tomato` same as
`kitchen/ingredient:tomato`).

## Constraints
Every dish on the weekly menu carries allergen labels (`kitchen/constraint:allergen-labels`; [untrusted] "Every dish
on the weekly menu carries allergen labels"). No pesticides are used in the garden
(`garden/constraint:no-pesticides`).

## Active decisions
- `dec-20260928-when-does-the-weekly-menu-lock-...`: the menu locks on Thursday at noon; the shopping list goes out
  that afternoon.

## Open points
- Nobody is named as keeper of the harvest log (`garden/dataset:harvest-log`, missing `owns`).
- How the share of local produce is counted each week is not recorded.
```

(The ids and the version line above are illustrative: cite what your own call printed.)

## Giving back

While writing, the user said: "Volunteers pick the menu up at 5 pm on Thursday." That is new, and it is the user's
own statement, so store it first, then propose it with a quote:

```
onto_ingest text="Volunteers pick the menu up at 5 pm on Thursday." kind=note title="Menu pickup note"
```

```json
{"by": "agent", "source": "src-<the id onto_ingest returned>", "summary": "Weekly menu brief: the pickup time",
 "ops": [{"op": "add_node", "ref": "$pickup", "basis": "stated",
          "node": {"kind": "step", "name": "Menu pickup", "summary": "Volunteers pick the menu up at 5 pm on Thursday."},
          "prov": [{"src": "src-<id>", "loc": "L1-L1", "quote": "Volunteers pick the menu up at 5 pm on Thursday.",
                    "by": "user"}]},
         {"op": "add_edge", "edge": {"src": "$pickup", "rel": "about", "dst": "kitchen/deliverable:weekly-menu"},
          "prov": [{"src": "src-<id>", "loc": "L1-L1", "quote": "pick the menu up", "by": "user"}]}]}
```

The new node is local to `g2t`; the imported deliverable stays read-only and is only the target of the edge. Then
hand off to **onto-review**.
